map.月经稀发 + 总睾酮升高 + 超声双侧卵巢多囊样改变（每侧≥12 个小卵泡）：满: Oligomenorrhoea plus raised total testosterone plus bilateral polycystic ovarian changes on ultrasound (at least 12 small follicles per ovary): 2 of the 3 items are met, so PCOS is diagnosed (phenotype A or B); thyroid disease, hyperprolactinaemia and congenital adrenal hyperplasia must be excluded.
map.鹿特丹与雄激素过多协会标准区别？: How do the Rotterdam and Androgen Excess Society criteria differ?
map.鹿特丹要求 3 项中 2 项，敏感性更高；AES 更强调高雄激素为核心。两者均需: Rotterdam asks for 2 of 3 items and is therefore more sensitive; the AES criteria put hyperandrogenism at the centre. Both still require exclusion of other causes of hyperandrogenism or ovulatory dysfunction.
map.表型分类有什么意义？: What is the point of phenotype classification?
map.A（排卵+高雄+PCOM 全有）代谢风险最高，D（仅排卵+PCOM）最低；表型指: Type A (ovulatory dysfunction, hyperandrogenism and PCOM all present) carries the highest metabolic risk and type D (ovulatory dysfunction plus PCOM) the lowest; the phenotype guides how intensive metabolic screening and fertility management should be.
map.PCOS是育龄期女性常见内分泌疾病，鹿特丹标准(需满足2/3)是国际通用诊断标准: PCOS is a common endocrine disease in women of reproductive age; the Rotterdam criteria (2 of 3 required) are the international standard, and other causes of hyperandrogenism must be excluded.
